SELECT is_current, tier, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT count(*) AS members_with_multiple_current FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)

SELECT count(*) AS members_total, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_ids, sum(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_ended, sum(CASE WHEN is_current <> (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flag_mismatch FROM dim_member
SELECT is_current, tier, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) m, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to) FROM stg_member_updates GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) AS current_not_latest FROM dim_member c WHERE c.is_current AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member o WHERE o.member_id=c.member_id AND o.member_key<>c.member_key AND o.valid_from > c.valid_from)

SELECT count(*) AS gold_current_total, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_ids, sum(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_join, sum(CASE WHEN join_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_join, sum(CASE WHEN valid_from > DATE '2026-10-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_valid FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold'

SELECT count(*) AS stg_rows, sum(CASE WHEN d.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS key_in_dim, sum(CASE WHEN d.member_key IS NOT NULL AND d.tier=s.tier AND d.valid_from=s.valid_from AND d.is_current=s.is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identical, sum(CASE WHEN d.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS key_missing
FROM stg_member_updates s LEFT JOIN dim_member d ON d.member_key=s.member_key

SELECT count(*) AS stg_current_rows, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member d WHERE d.member_id=s.member_id AND d.is_current AND d.tier=s.tier AND d.valid_from=s.valid_from) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_current_in_dim, sum(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member d WHERE d.member_id=s.member_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS member_not_in_dim FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE s.is_current

SELECT min(member_id), max(member_id), min(length(CAST(member_id AS VARCHAR))) minlen, max(length(CAST(member_id AS VARCHAR))) maxlen, count(DISTINCT home_store_id) stores, sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan_home, min(join_date), max(join_date), sum(CASE WHEN marketing_consent IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_consent FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold'
